target_gpu: RTX 3060 proxy (RTX 2060 Super remains release target)
anchor_policy: TSR anchors use the P2a view-family primary resolution-fraction upper bound recorded in the summary, with r.DynamicRes.OperationMode=0; one anchor before treatment block, one after each four treatments, and one final anchor.
dlss_mode_selection: Phase 1 compares Quality, Balanced, and Performance three times each. Select the mode with highest median avg_fps only among modes with three active-mode witnesses, no baseline drift beyond 5%, no p99 regression above 5% vs TSR, and owner image-quality acceptance. Phase 2 is separate and requires that accepted mode plus its recorded primary fraction upper bound; Dynamic Resolution must be disabled for all runs.

clouds.reason: Do not use the non-existent r.VolumetricCloud.ViewRaySampleCountScale. UE 5.5 source confirms r.VolumetricCloud.ViewRaySampleMaxCount and r.VolumetricCloud.Shadow.ViewRaySampleMaxCount; runtime help confirmation and owner-approved cloud experiment are still required before adding either to Round 6.

execution: Run -Round6 for Phase 1 mode comparisons first (13 runs). Select a best mode only if three active-mode witnesses, baseline drift <=5%, p99 regression <=5% vs TSR, and owner image-quality acceptance all pass. Then run -Round6Tuning separately with the selected mode and recorded primary fraction upper bounds (16 runs). Keep r.DynamicRes.OperationMode=0 throughout. Each phase's anchors are explicit; active-upscaler, mode-witness, and fraction-upper-bound preflight must pass before proceeding.
